title: Space Oddity · David Bowie
description: The full original music with a physical mouth singing the words, and a second mouth speaking the overlapping launch countdown. Both follow the recording with synchronized words and mouth animation.

parts.name: Robotic singer
parts.role: One mouth · source melody and phrasing

melody.name: Space Oddity
melody.lyrics: ground control to major Tom ground control to major Tom take your protein pills and put your helmet on Ground control to major Tom. Commencing countdown engines on. Check ignition and may god's love be with you This is ground control to Major Tom, You've really made the grade. And the papers want to know whose shirts you wear. Now it's time to leave the capsule, if you dare. This is Major Tom to ground control, I'm stepping through the door. And I'm floating in a most peculiar way. And the stars look very different today For here am I sitting in a tin can Far above the world Planet Earth is blue and there's nothing I can do Though I'm past one hundred thousand miles, I'm feeling very still. And I think my spaceship knows which way to go. Tell my wife I love her very much, she knows. Ground control to Major Tom, your circuit's dead, there's something wrong. Can you hear me, Major Tom? Can you hear me, Major Tom? Can you hear me, Major Tom? Can you Here am I floating round my tin can? Far above the moon. Planet Earth is blue, and there's nothing I can do.
melody.source: The user-supplied recording: source-aligned consonants, held vowels, late diphthong glides and reviewed melody targets. Introductory vocal and later verses use their recorded registers, with restrained delayed vibrato and a +5.2-cent tuning offset from the median instrumental estimate.
